name: app-theme-v2-keyframes-accepted
description: Per-mode keyframes text that is exactly `@keyframes <ident> { … }` blocks (two blocks, a comment, frame selectors of every kind) is ACCEPTED by appThemeSchema — the slot carries what the card injects verbatim after the variables (ggui#987 §3.3, follower D).

keyframes.light:
/* entrance */ @keyframes entrance { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px) } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: none } }
@keyframes accent-pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.7}}
keyframes.dark: @keyframes spin { from { transform: rotate(0deg) } to { transform: rotate(360deg) } }
